mapper.update: UPDATE okx_fund_safety_state SET status = 'HALTED', reason = #{reason}, source = #{source}, resume_reason = NULL, last_action_error = NULL, halted_at = #{haltedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_scope = #{accountScope} AND status <> 'HALTED'

UPDATE okx_fund_safety_state SET status = 'ACTIVE', resume_reason = #{resumeReason}, last_action_error = NULL, resumed_at = #{resumedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_scope = #{accountScope} AND status = 'HALTED' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
